33/G.goal: Explain the purpose, preservation need, and VR system goals of the Majuli XR case study.
33/G.achieves: Prepares the learner to understand and implement an XR system for cultural heritage preservation by framing what the case study addresses and what the system is meant to provide.

33/O1.goal: Present the Majuli case study and the preservation problem it addresses.
33/O1.achieves: Gives the learner the cultural and environmental context needed to understand why this case study is used to teach XR system development.

33/O2.goal: Explain the rationale and intended outcomes of the Majuli VR preservation system.
33/O2.achieves: Enables the learner to connect the preservation need to the VR system's purpose and to follow its later requirements, design, and implementation.
